concept: Review and integration: a personal commitment to intellectual honesty, even at a cost
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across challenging your own views, speaking truth to power, and evaluating expertise — what's your personal throughline?
exercise.practice: Adult writes a short personal statement on what truth-seeking means to them in practice

assessment.success_marker: adult produces a personal statement referencing at least two of the three adult-stage scenarios
